about: c12 inserts (user on c11: 「還不夠，繼續加」, then reuse existing material for free). Each insert cuts away from a c11 shot and back without moving any c11 cut: the c11 shot keeps its own clock underneath (main.js pickShot), so it resumes where it would have been. A 'take' insert plays a window of an earlier generated take at normal speed (seq.py writes seq/<id>, source SHA-256 checked); a 'still' insert is an approved plate moved by the code camera. Camera [centre x, centre y, zoom] in source px, 'from' -> 'to'. start: 'at_word' [line, word] two frames early like build.py's vocal cuts, or 'at_beat' (index into beats.json). end: the same, or 'cut' (the insert runs into that c11 cut). Rule (user on the takes): no visible singing mouth, no frown; only hands/profile/eyes/hair/wide/environment moments. 'pips' are picture-in-picture insets (480x270 frames under comp/pip/<id>, drawn on the feed layer by main.js).
decision: user 2026-11-03 on c11: 「還不夠，繼續加」; direction 「兩條都做 (Recommended)」, c12 = free reuse of existing material (logs/decisions.md)
